::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 3/1870  
**From:** Secretary of State, Home Department Smeeth  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA collection 100 box 119
:::

Dear Miss Yonge
Your letter has only reached me this morning. February will do very well for my Fairy tale to appear, as far as I am concerned—I only wanted to know its fate, & shall be glad to have it in the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) rather than worked into one of my books.[^1]

I have directed Macmillan to send you [my new book](other_books/otherbook_798.qmd), which I hope will please you

yrs truly
[E. H. Knatchbull-Hugessen](people/person_819.qmd)

---

[^1]: 'The Search after Happiness' *MP* (February 1871), 200.
